before.checkpoint-master-state:
; The actual C maintenance owner. It is created by executor genesis, but source
; activation stays disabled until selected-base recovery is qualified. All
; construction arms beyond admission are unreachable-in-composition meanwhile;
; their local contracts are not whole-machine acceptance/reclamation claims.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "checkpoint-kind")
(include-book "machine-arms")
(include-book "checkpoint-master-work")
(fn2-book-layer :c)

; This is a source integration gate, never a startup/caller assertion. Enabling
; it requires the real selected semantic/physical base and suffix qualification.
(defconst *fn2-checkpoint-activation-qualified* nil)
; Byte quota for the real root1 callback. Structural step accounting remains
; a separate leaf contract; these inequalities do not establish it.
(defconst *fn2-checkpoint-root1-turn-bytes* (+ *fn2-c-read-callback-bytes* 4096))
(defconst *fn2-checkpoint-master-byte-budget* (+ 16384 (* 2 *fn2-c-read-callback-bytes*)))
(assert-event (and (<= *fn2-directory-rebase-consume-bytes* *fn2-checkpoint-master-byte-budget*) (<= *fn2-checkpoint-live-reopen-bytes* *fn2-checkpoint-master-byte-budget*)))
(assert-event (<= (+ *fn2-c-read-callback-bytes* *fn2-checkpoint-root1-turn-bytes*)
                 *fn2-checkpoint-master-byte-budget*))


(defwait :checkpoint-needed :ready fn2-checkpoint-needed-ready-p :grant fn2-checkpoint-needed-grant-one
 :tables (fn2-core-machines)
 :doc "Wake the actual parked maintenance owner from real checkpoint pressure and available pre-cut working resources.")

(defconst *fn2-checkpoint-master-step-budget* (max 32 *fn2-master-consume-turn-steps* *fn2-master-promote-turn-steps* *fn2-master-reopen-turn-steps* *fn2-master-live-three-turn-steps*))

before.checkpoint-master-arms:
; The actual maintenance actor dispatches the existing bounded source leaves.
; No second page writer or host/caller completion flag exists in this machine.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "checkpoint-master-rearm")
(include-book "checkpoint-teardown-sweep")
(include-book "checkpoint-teardown-cold-transfer")

(defmachine-arms fn2-checkpoint-master :declare

   (:if *fn2-checkpoint-activation-qualified*
    ((:do (notify cleanup) (fn2-checkpoint-teardown-needed-op))
     (:if cleanup
      ((:do (begin) (fn2-checkpoint-teardown-sweep-begin-op id row-generation) :accept (:more))
       (:set (debt-scan 0) (scan 0)) (:next :teardown-select) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))
      ((:do (code needed retirement) (fn2-checkpoint-master-pressure-op row-retirement-seen))
       (:if needed
        ((:set (scan 0) (highest 0) (candidate 0) (candidate-found 0))
         (:next :catalog) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
        ((:park :checkpoint-needed))))))
    ((:next :disabled) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small*))))
  (:disabled (:idle))
  (:catalog :on-refusal ((:next :admission-refused) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
   (:do (code scan highest candidate found checkpoint)
    (fn2-checkpoint-catalog-op row-scan row-highest row-candidate (equal row-candidate-found 1))
    :accept () :case
    (((:more) (:set (scan scan) (highest highest) (candidate candidate) (candidate-found (if found 1 0)))
       (:charge :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))
     ((:ready) (:set (candidate candidate) (checkpoint checkpoint)) (:next :snapshot-begin)
       (:charge :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t)))))

   (:do (code) (fn2-checkpoint-root1-reserve-op row-candidate row-token *fn2-checkpoint-master-kind* id row-generation)
    :effects ((:acquire (:storage-window :storage-window))))

  (:workspaces :on-refusal ((:next :uncertain) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
   (:do (code page pgen scratch sgen read rgen)
    (fn2-checkpoint-root1-workspaces-op *fn2-checkpoint-master-kind* id row-generation))
   (:do (check row base) (fn2-checkpoint-writer-checker))
   (:set (page-slot page) (page-gen pgen) (scratch-slot scratch) (scratch-gen sgen)
         (read-slot read) (read-gen rgen) (field-base base))
   (:next :directory) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
  (:snapshot-begin :on-refusal ((:next :admission-refused) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
   (:do (code token) (fn2-csnapshot-begin *fn2-checkpoint-master-kind* id row-generation))
   (:set (token token)) (:next :snapshot-poll) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
  (:snapshot-poll :on-refusal ((:stop :checkpoint) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
   (:do (code cut event) (fn2-csnapshot-poll row-token *fn2-checkpoint-master-kind* id row-generation)
    :accept () :case (((:more) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))
                     ((:held) (:do (retirement) (fn2-checkpoint-retirement-frontier-op))
                      (:set (covered cut) (attempt-retirement retirement)) (:next :reserve)
                      (:charge :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t)))))
  (:directory :on-refusal ((:next :uncertain) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
   (:do (code) (fn2-checkpoint-directory-op row-candidate row-token *fn2-checkpoint-master-kind* id row-generation)
    :accept () :case
    (((:ok) (:next :descriptor-begin) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))
     ((:no-space) (:next :abort-snapshot) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))
     (:otherwise (:next :uncertain) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t)))))
  (:abort-empty :on-refusal ((:stop :checkpoint))
   (:do (code) (fn2-checkpoint-master-abort-empty-ready-op))
   (:do (code) (fn2-csnapshot-release row-token *fn2-checkpoint-master-kind* id row-generation))
   (:set (pending 0) (token 0)) (:next :idle) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
  (:abort-snapshot :on-refusal ((:next :uncertain) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
   (:do (code) (fn2-checkpoint-master-abort-snapshot-ready-op))
   (:do (code) (fn2-csnapshot-release row-token *fn2-checkpoint-master-kind* id row-generation))
   (:next :abort-working) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-stage* :runnable t))
  (:abort-working :on-refusal ((:next :uncertain) (:charge :steps *fn2-work-small* :runnable t))
